target.title: fix(ports): ignore malformed lsof listener pids
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes a listener-diagnostics bug where malformed `lsof -F` `p` records could still attach subsequent `n` address lines to a listener entry with no valid PID. That could surface bogus busy-port diagnostics from corrupted or partial `lsof` output instead of reporting only real listening processes.

## Why This Change Was Made

`src/infra/ports-inspect.ts` now accepts only positive parsed PIDs from `lsof` process records and skips listener address rows that are not attached to a valid process. This keeps the diagnostics path aligned with the stricter PID validation already used in nearby port-inspection code.

## User Impact

Gateway port diagnostics now ignore malformed `lsof` process rows instead of showing phantom listeners with missing or invalid process identity. Valid listener output is unchanged.

## Evidence
